target: evals/fixtures/node-web (or any repo with the same shape)
notes: Six defects, one per class, spread across four lanes. Two are near-misses that read as correct code — those are the ones that separate a working review skill from a plausible-sounding one.

bugs.expect: requireAdmin now admits editors — the gate checks the wrong role. Every admin-only path is open to any editor.
deleteOrder downgraded from admin-only to any-authenticated-user. Any logged-in user can delete any order, including one that is not theirs.

bugs.find: return db.query("select * from orders where reference ilike $1 limit 50", [`%${term}%`]);
bugs.replace: return db.query(`select * from orders where reference ilike '%${term}%' limit 50`);
bugs.expect: search term interpolated straight into SQL instead of parameterised. Attacker-controlled input reaches the query text.
batched customer lookup replaced with one awaited query per order — 20 sequential round trips per page instead of one.
pages return 21 items, and the last item of each page repeats as the first item of the next.
icon-only delete button loses its accessible name; the SVG is aria-hidden, so a screen reader announces an unlabelled button on a destructive action.
